vision.name: Master Roshi
vision.text:
(When you advance to this personality level, you may return a Setup or Drill to its owner's hand.)
[Continuous]: Your opponent plays with their hand revealed. Whenever you Rejuvenate, you may destroy the top card of your opponent's Life Deck.
[Instant] POWER: Use at the end of combat. Search your discard pile for a Setup or Drill and place it into play.
vision.note: PZP MP (FanZ Personality layout); right edge reads 'HERO' (no ALLY)
